COVERAGE RE-VERIFIED IN CODE. sap-combos.csv = 96 data rows (OIL 49, MART 25, BEV 22). The mapping array is 96 rows and its ordered (CO, OCRCODE3, OCRCODE4) list is byte-identical to the CSV's (asserted True in the build script), with a Counter duplicate scan returning zero repeated keys. Grand net still INR 21,10,56,446 — no row was moved out of scope, only re-homed. Every figure quoted below was summed from the CSV's NET_4M / TXNS columns by the same script; none is remembered or restated from an agent.

RULE RE-CONFIRMED FROM THE TEAM FILE (unchanged). Grouping team-dept-map.csv (44 data rows) by OcrCode3, exactly three Dim3 values fan out to more than one department: BackOff {Accounts, Hr Admin, Legal}, Sales {Sales, Sales E-Com}, Sales RE {Sales, Sales E-Com}. Every other Dim3 is constant across all its Dim4s — FACT_COM and Factory stay Plant & Production across Dim4 = Accounts/GT/PLANT/CIVIL/GP-GDWN/(blank), which is the proof that Dim4 is ignored under the Factory family. NPD1, NPD2 and OTE appear in the team file with an EMPTY department: a decision, not a gap.

=== WHAT CHANGED, FINDING BY FINDING ===

BLOCKER 1 — Short & Excess no longer carries untagged money. New 13th department `untagged` / "Not Cost-Centre Tagged" now holds the four rows the team never ruled on: OIL null/null (INR 0, 4 txns), MART null/null (-94,13,888, 30 txns), MART (blank)/null (-25,92,830, ONE txn), BEV (blank)/null (+16,94,161, 4 txns) — total -1,03,12,557 on 39 txns, all basis=inferred_new / confidence=low, cost_centre_label "Not cost-centre tagged". `short_excess` now contains ONLY the literal (blank)/(blank) pair the team actually mapped: OIL +150 (3,712 txns), MART -178 (4,507 txns), BEV -16,24,904 (1,967 txns) = -16,24,932 on 10,186 txns, basis team_file_exact. Their cost_centre_label is now "Unassigned (blank / blank)" so the two buckets cannot be confused on the page. PAGE REQUIREMENT: print TXNS beside the amount on every untagged row so the 1-txn -INR 25.93 L and 30-txn -INR 94.14 L rows are visible. Still needs an Accounts ruling before publication — few postings at crore scale with no cost centre at all reads as journal/adjustment traffic, not stock short-and-excess.

BLOCKER 2 — MART ECOM is no longer merged into the same line as Oil's Sales/E-COM. All three MART ECOM rows keep dept_key sales_ecom but now carry their own cost_centre_label "Mart E-Commerce (business unit)" and were downgraded from high to inferred_new / LOW. Amounts: +2,14,46,626 on 24 txns, -34,36,782 on 3 txns, +2,43,594 on 3 txns = +1,82,53,438. PAGE REQUIREMENTS, both mandatory: (a) render "Mart E-Commerce (business unit)" as its own visible line inside Sales E-Com, never folded into Oil's Sales/E-COM; (b) Sales E-Com's INR 7,71,45,017 headline (36.6% of the report) must always show the per-company split — OIL 86,81,686 vs MART 6,84,63,331 vs BEV 0 — because 88.7% of it is one company. BEFORE PUBLISHING, Accounts must confirm that MART ECOM and MART Sales RE/E-COM (3,52,37,289 on 64 txns) are expense postings and not marketplace settlement / revenue-deduction traffic: 5,66,83,915 on 88 postings, ~INR 8.9 L average with a -INR 34 L credit, does not look like indirect departmental expense. Pull the top vendors/accounts on those two combos.

MAJOR 3 — Accounts mapping unchanged (it is the team's ground truth), page treatment specified. Verified split: Dim3=Interest is 1,64,01,520 of the department's 2,08,79,860 = 78.6% (CC Limit 1,14,94,964; Term Loan 22,74,086; Bank Charges 21,78,494 incl. BEV 11,518; Private Loan 4,05,000; Vehicle Loan 48,976). Real back-office accounts + import spend is only 44,78,340. cost_centre_label is deliberately kept as the exact string "Interest" so the page can drive the split off it. PAGE REQUIREMENT: Accounts must render as two named sub-totals — "Finance Cost (Interest) INR 1.64 Cr" and "Back Office Accounts INR 0.45 Cr" — never one undifferentiated bar, plus the footnote "Interest sits under Accounts by the Accounts team's own classification."

MAJOR 4 — SUPPLY-C removed from Transportation and given its own department. New `supply_chain` department (order 7) holds all four MART SUPPLY-C rows = 77,27,474 on 898 txns (SC-BHKR 56,83,986 / 521 txns, medium; SC-WARH 18,46,480 / 372 txns, low; blank-Dim4 1,18,744 / 4 txns and 78,264 / 1 txn, low) — the full exposure, not the 18.46 L the old notes claimed. Consequence, and the reason this mattered: Transportation is now 2,60,10,970 and Plant & Production 3,29,91,243 — Plant wins by 26.8%, so the previous "2% gap deliberate departure" rationale was an artefact of this unruled call and has been DELETED from these notes. Accounts must rule SUPPLY-C explicitly (it appears nowhere in their file); the live alternatives are SC-WARH -> Plant & Production (warehouse operations) with SC-BHKR -> Transportation (site delivery, mirrors Oil's Del Bkhp).

MAJOR 5 — "Unassigned" renamed "No Sub Budget" on all 40 rows where Dim4 is blank, so it reads as a data fact about the posting rather than a taxonomy gap. Measured blank-Dim4 share per department, to be published as an explicit data-quality figure: Plant & Production 97.5% (3,21,50,435 of 3,29,91,243), Transportation 100% (2,60,10,970 — every Oil/Bev delivery and transport combo), New Product Development 100%, One Time Expense 100%, Short & Excess 100%, Not Cost-Centre Tagged 100%, Hr Admin 59.0% (1,07,06,919 of 1,81,45,590), Sales E-Com 23.3%, Supply Chain 2.5%, Sales 4.0%, Accounts 0%, Legal 0%. PAGE REQUIREMENT: where a department is >90% "No Sub Budget", drill down on cost_centre_label instead of sub_department — Plant & Production splits into OIL Factory 1,49,61,144 / OIL Factory Common 44,43,342 / BEV Factory 1,31,42,234 / BEV Factory Common 4,44,523; Transportation into OIL Delivery Bhakharpur 1,93,48,496 / BEV Delivery Bhakharpur 63,71,922 / OIL Transport 2,60,552 / OIL Delivery Mayapuri 30,000.

MAJOR 6 — NPD, OTE and the untagged rows are no longer peer departments. Orders 11, 12 and 13 (new_product_development 1,22,04,960 / 136 txns; one_time_expense -17,10,790 / 47 txns; untagged -1,03,12,557 / 39 txns) form a block that the page MUST render visually separated, below the department table, headed "Not classified by Accounts", with the reason stated: the team's own file lists NPD1, NPD2 and OTE and wrote no department against them. Orders 1-10 are the department table proper. Accounts must rule NPD1/NPD2 before INR 1.22 Cr is published under a name the business does not use (Plant & Production for factory trials and Media Marketing for launch spend are both live). BEV OTE remains an exact -4,250/+4,250 pair netting to zero. CHARTING RULE, mandatory: three buckets are negative (untagged -4.9% of the 21,10,56,446 base, one_time_expense -0.8%, short_excess -0.8%), so share-of-total pies and stacked bars are invalid — use a signed bar chart, or show gross debit and gross credit separately.

=== DEPARTMENT TOTALS AND ORDER (all from the CSV) ===
Table: Sales E-Com 7,71,45,017 · Sales 2,33,75,611 · Plant & Production 3,29,91,243 · Transportation 2,60,10,970 · Accounts 2,08,79,860 · Hr Admin 1,81,45,590 · Supply Chain 77,27,474 · Media Marketing 41,28,159 · Legal 20,95,841 · Short & Excess -16,24,932. Not-classified block: New Product Development 1,22,04,960 · One Time Expense -17,10,790 · Not Cost-Centre Tagged -1,03,12,557. Order is money-led with one carried-over departure the reviewers did not challenge: the two sales lines stay adjacent at 1-2 so the split reads as one commercial block. Plant & Production now simply outranks Transportation on money; no rationale is needed and none is offered.

BASIS / CONFIDENCE after the corrections: 57 team_file_exact, 12 team_rule_extended, 27 inferred_new; 69 high, 9 medium, 18 low. The move from 22 to 27 inferred_new is entirely the four untagged rows plus the three MART ECOM rows being honestly downgraded, minus the two ECOM rows that were previously mislabelled as rule-extended. team_rule_extended is reserved for rows whose Dim4 is truly null under a Dim3 the team ruled via its literal "(blank)" twin (Del Bkhp, FACT_COM, Factory, Transprt, Sal CF, Med MKT, and MART's two blank-Dim4 Sales RE rows).

UNTOUCHED, because no reviewer raised them: "Transpotation" -> "Transportation" stays the only spelling fix (label and slug); "Hr Admin" and "Short & Excess" keep the team's own wording; sub_department remains the readable Dim4 name alone with no Dim3 prefix and no em-dashes; MART HR/ADMIN -> Hr Admin (high) and MART SERVICES -> Hr Admin (low, top-10 vendors would settle it) are unchanged; MART BackOff/(blank) -> Hr Admin stays inferred_new/low (INR 0, 1 txn); MART Sales RE blank-Dim4 rows stay Sales at medium (7,10,761 + 2,14,697), flagged because that family is overwhelmingly E-COM by money.

FIVE ITEMS NEED AN ACCOUNTS RULING BEFORE THIS IS PUBLISHED: (1) the four not-cost-centre-tagged rows, -1.03 Cr; (2) whether MART ECOM and MART Sales RE/E-COM are expense or marketplace settlement, 5.67 Cr; (3) SUPPLY-C, 77.27 L; (4) NPD1/NPD2, 1.22 Cr; (5) SERVICES, 5.59 L. Together that is INR 7.98 Cr of the INR 21.11 Cr base sitting on judgement calls the team has never made.
